MANUAL_REVIEW.title: Sengoku Basara: Sanada Yukimura-Den
MANUAL_REVIEW.genre: Musou/hack-and-slash, but framed as a single-character narrative drama rather than a roster-battle entry
MANUAL_REVIEW.reasoning: Named investigation target from the task. Confirmed no English localization exists anywhere for this title (unlike the series' one Western attempt, 'Devil Kings,' which was a different, altered game and long discontinued). Unlike sibling id 2726 (a roster-battle rerelease, classified KEEP above), this entry is explicitly billed as 'the series' first dedicated single-character drama focused entirely on Yukimura's story rather than a full roster battle' — meaning the story, which requires Japanese, may be more central to this specific entry's value than typical action-carve-out titles. Recommend Josh's judgment on whether the hack-and-slash gameplay alone justifies keeping it despite the story being inaccessible.
